presentation_title: Intro to Natural Language Processing and Its Techniques

key_points: NLP is a branch of AI focused on enabling computers to understand and generate human language.
Integrates computational linguistics, machine learning, and deep learning for processing unstructured data.
Common applications include virtual assistants, search engines, and automated customer service.
Text Preprocessing: Essential for transforming raw text into a structured format for analysis.
Tokenization: Splits text into smaller units (tokens) for easier processing.
Stop Word Removal: Eliminates common words that add little meaning, reducing noise in data.
Sentiment Analysis: Automatically gauges emotional tone, valuable for brand monitoring and customer feedback.
Text Summarization: Condenses lengthy documents into concise summaries, enhancing information accessibility.
Word Sense Disambiguation: Resolves multiple meanings of words based on context, improving text understanding.

slides.slide_title: Machine Learning and Deep Learning in NLP
key_points: Neural Networks (RNNs): Effective for sequential data, enhancing language modeling and text generation.
Transformers: Utilize self-attention mechanisms, powering modern Large Language Models (LLMs) like GPT.
Transfer Learning: Leverages pre-trained models for improved performance with minimal data.
Bag-of-Words (BoW): Represents text as an unordered collection of word frequencies, simplifying analysis.
TF-IDF: Evaluates word relevance in documents, aiding in effective text classification.
Word Embeddings: Techniques like Word2Vec map words to dense vectors, capturing semantic relationships.
Automated Customer Support: Chatbots enhance customer service efficiency and satisfaction.
Market Analysis: Sentiment analysis provides insights into consumer opinions and trends.
Content Management: Text summarization and classification streamline information retrieval and organization.
Increased Adoption: Businesses are leveraging NLP for data-driven decision-making.
Enhanced User Experience: NLP technologies improve interaction with customers through personalization.
Continuous Innovation: Ongoing advancements in NLP techniques will drive new applications and efficiencies.
